```{r}
cell <- c("CX1", "CX2")
treated <- c(TRUE, FALSE)
num_cells_before <- c(5415, 8123)
num_cells_after <- c(1432, 7543)

my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = num_cells_before,
  num_cells_after = num_cells_after
)
gt(my_data_frame)
```
